what: Planned /tmp snapshot uses raw ls under a set -e harness
scenario_or_breakage: A clean runner with no /tmp/larch-codex-home-* makes ls return nonzero before the launcher runs, so the new cleanup test can abort instead of asserting leaks
suggested_fix: Specify a guarded snapshot helper, e.g. { ls -d /tmp/larch-codex-home-* 2>/dev/null || true; } | sort, or use find which exits 0 on no matches
